messages.content:
Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "sched-repair-medium-02", "row_sha256": "dcdd19858dbf01ebd3b769c7954bebe2b34174791fecb2815939934e5c00078b", "mode": "/polish", "language": "en", "context": {"level": "high", "profile": "technical note"}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Rewrite awkward phrasing into readable prose for the supplied profile, or plain prose when none is supplied. Preserve intent and certainty. Do not add a greeting, subject, signature, conclusion, or fact that the input did not supply.", "input": "When handling failed payment refund requests across our distributed billing workers, the service must execute retries with extreme operational caution.

Retry the refund request three times scratch that five times using exponential backoff starting at two seconds. If the remote payment gateway returns an invalid card token error or merchant account mismatch, do not retry the operation under any circumstances and flag the transaction record for manual compliance review.

Cancel that retry counter if the customer account is marked suspended no wait if the customer account is closed, and notify the payments on-call channel immediately. In addition, record structured audit metrics capturing transaction identifier, refund amount, and failure codes in the primary accounting database before terminating the worker execution. Daily summary reports should be emailed to the compliance auditor.", "output": "When handling failed payment refund requests across our distributed billing workers, the service must execute retries with extreme operational caution.

Retry the refund request 5 times using exponential backoff starting at 2 seconds. If the remote payment gateway returns an invalid card token error or merchant account mismatch, do not retry the operation under any circumstances and flag the transaction record for manual compliance review.

Cancel that retry counter if the customer account is closed, and notify the payments on-call channel immediately. In addition, record structured audit metrics capturing transaction identifier, refund amount, and failure codes in the primary accounting database before terminating the worker execution. Daily summary reports should be emailed to the compliance auditor."}]
